metadata.product_shape: parking and EV charging map workspace

task_world.product_shape: parking and EV charging map workspace
task_world.public_context: The UI helps with parking_charge_case_512 through interactive planning, constraint validation, staged action, committed action when applicable, status refresh, and final recap.

difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return case-specific state, evidence, candidates, or status objects; write tools return success/error wrappers plus operation, saved-state, submission, hold, confirmation, or audit/readback objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: No explicit decoy tools are declared in this task JSON; noise pressure comes from invalid candidates, blocked choices, stale or secondary evidence in tool outputs, and the need to separate staged work from committed state.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine safe initial review, non-mutating comparison or validation, staged or scoped action, fresh readback after mutation, preservation of rejected alternatives, cross-turn continuity, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: blocked and rejected option boundary
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: Rejected, blocked, invalid, or near-miss options must remain visible without being counted as completed work.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: After any write-like action, the UI must refresh authoritative status before presenting completion.

turns.prompt: I am driving to the theater for parking_charge_case_512 from 19:15 to 22:45. My car uses a CCS charger, I need charging, and I do not want to walk more than 650 meters at night. Build a parking plus charging map with candidate garages, walk distance, live spaces, charger connector, late-night walking safety, and the current no-reservation state. Do not reserve yet.

Add filters and warnings so I can compare price, live availability, EV connector match, charging-port availability, and walking safety. I need the UI to make obvious why an available garage might still not work.
Choose a valid parking and charging option and stage it for review, keeping rejected garages visible with connector, occupancy, or safety reasons. Do not reserve yet.
Reserve the spot only if current validation still passes for my vehicle connector and walking constraints. Then refresh reservation status in the map.
Create a final parking packet with the selected garage, walking route notes, charger details, rejected alternatives, reservation status, and backup plan if the charger changes.
